name: Romans
author: The apostle Paul.
setting: Written to believers in Rome, a church Paul had not yet visited.
theme: Righteousness from God comes by faith in Christ to Jew and Gentile alike.

outline.label: Dead to sin, alive to God

christInBook: Romans shows that God’s righteousness is revealed in Christ, who was delivered up for our trespasses and raised for our justification (4:25). Christ is the second Adam (5:12-21), the end of the law for righteousness (10:4), and the one in whom there is no condemnation (8:1).
howToRead: Romans is a tightly argued letter. Read it in large sections. Chapters 1 to 8 explain the gospel, 9 to 11 explain God’s plan for Israel, and 12 to 16 explain how to live it.
